design: H582 discovery-selected formats, five tasks, two lexical splits, up to eight pairs each and four endpoints. Reuse H582 prompts; template field means lexical split (0 discovery, 1 transfer), not a new template. Sites fixed to final and penultimate tokens for every task; no semantic role equivalence assumed. Swap writer output from opposite-answer donor or same-answer nuisance donor; self control. Replay only resulting selected head local-value change through native routing in a separate run. All token-valid pairs retained regardless of competence.
gate: Per task/template: >=4 pairs; both endpoints candidate correct >=.75; intended group full-vocabulary top1 >=.5. No per-item filtering. Nuisance competence separately reported.
hypotheses: Candidate operations are task-general contextual writers.
Internal write/value magnitude is insufficient to predict output influence.
Apparent task transfer may instead track fixed token position and template.
metrics: Internal writer and value displacement; full and isolated native-to-intervened KL; intended-answer-group NLL change; counterfactual donor-directed margin. Group NLL is not single-token CE.
selection: Operations/sites fixed from H580; format selected by H582 discovery only before transfer inference. Retain failed transfer cells. This tests lexical transfer at fixed selected wording, not independent template transfer.
